candidates.title: BJA FY 2026 Second Chance Act Family-Based Substance Use Disorder Treatment Program
candidates.funder: U.S. Department of Justice, Bureau of Justice Assistance
why_fit: Directly funds family-based substance use disorder treatment and recovery support for parents with minor children or pregnant parents under correctional control.
Expressly allows nonprofit and faith-based organizations under Category 2, including nonprofits without 501(c)(3) status according to the Grants.gov applicant-type listing.
Strong overlap with Broken Growth Ministries' reentry, stabilization, family-support and recovery-oriented service model.
candidates.eligibility_note: Official BJA/Grants.gov material states nonprofit and faith-based organizations may apply under Category 2. Full FY2026 packet must still be parsed for service-delivery, correctional-control, treatment-provider, partnership and registration requirements before treating the application as submission-ready.
needs_user: Confirm whether Broken Growth will directly provide or formally partner with a qualified substance-use-disorder treatment provider.
Confirm the proposed correctional-control setting or referral/partnership pathway for eligible parents.
Confirm family-service design, staffing, partner commitments, budget, outcomes and any required clinical/licensure facts; do not infer or invent them.

candidates.title: FY 2027 AmeriCorps Seniors RSVP
why_fit: FY2027 priorities expressly include reducing homelessness, affordable-housing development or renovation, helping people experiencing homelessness find and maintain housing, behavioral-health and substance-use support, strong families and workforce re-entry support.
The program can build a structured 55+ volunteer corps around mentoring, navigation, housing support, recovery support and community-service functions.
Grants.gov lists nonprofits with and without 501(c)(3) status among eligible applicant types.
needs_user: Confirm the service geography/project area selected for the RSVP competition and whether that geography is available in the FY2027 notice.
Confirm proposed 55+ volunteer recruitment target, service roles and supervision model.
Confirm budget, required non-federal share or match after packet parsing, staffing and performance-measure commitments.
